title: (No AI) Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
author: Emma Roth
content:
![Digital collage of various toy robots.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/03/STK414_AI_CVIRGINIA_C.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Autonomous agents are the hottest thing in AI. OpenAI, Meta, Google, Instinct, and others promise their agents can scour the internet on your behalf, doing anything from booking a dinner reservation and cleaning out your inbox to buying new shoes. But what happens when the rest of the internet won't play nice?

In recent weeks, users of services like Meta's Muse, xAI's Grok, OpenAI's Dots, and Instinct have reported blocks preventing their AI agents from performing tasks across top websites. Yelp [told _TechCrunch_](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/06/the-next-hurdle-for-ai-agents-getting-websites-to-let-them-in/) that it only allows AI agents that pay for its data licensing program, while Delta Air Lines is preventing them from booking ticket …

title: (No AI) A week with RTX Spark: everything we’ve learned using Nvidia’s new laptops
author: Antonio G. Di Benedetto
content:
![RTX Spark versions of the HP OmniBook Ultra (left), an Asus ProArt P16 (center), and a Lenovo Yoga 9n (right) on a dark gray table against a green-illuminated backdrop.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/268814_Nvidia_RTX_Spark_laptops_Asus_HP_Lenovo_ADiBenedetto_0001.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Nvidia’s new SoC is available in Windows laptops from six different manufacturers. We’ve collectively tested four of them so far. | Photo: Antonio G. Di Benedetto / The Verge

Nvidia's RTX Spark N1X processor is finally here, and we've been collectively testing a small fortune's worth of powerful laptops sporting this new "superchip." RTX Spark is designed to be a high-performing Arm-based SoC for laptops and small desktop computers, rivaling the best from Apple, Intel, AMD, and Qualcomm. It has loads of cores, Nvidia RTX Blackwell graphics, and enough power and unified memory to run sizable local AI models.

The flagship placement is inside Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra with a staggering 128GB of unified memory, which our own [Tom Warren fully reviewed](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1012628/microsoft-surface-laptop-ultra-review). Sean Hollister has been testing a 64GB version of the Asus …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1012748/nvidia-rtx-spark-windows-arm-laptops-asus-hp-lenovo-impressions)
